what: Compact extract of the interpretability minimal pilot's analysis metrics (Qwen3-8B, yes/no readout). Values are copied unchanged from the analysis run's metrics.json; keys starting with 'derived_' are summaries of copied booleans (runs of consecutive layers), nothing else is recomputed. The full file (per-layer curves of every group with intervals, placebo floors) stays on the cluster.
note: calibration readouts against provisional bands; no verdicts (section M)
bonferroni: normal intervals from the bootstrap SE (amendment 2, B5)
